config.size_match_rule: size ratio <= 3 (implemented as |log1p(s1)-log1p(s2)| <= log(3)); i.e. matched within a factor of three on files_total, within ecosystem

size_matched.matching: without-replacement nearest-neighbour control selection on files_total within ecosystem, accepted when the file-count ratio is at most 3 (|log1p(s1)-log1p(s2)| <= log 3); 255 controls selected for the fixed set of 360 malicious pairs, all positives retained, so 105 malicious pairs have no individually matched control

notes.version_context: Version-context (predecessor) values are not computed in this file. They are in results/version_context_primary_final.json, computed on the primary malicious pairs with the predecessor features these pairs carry (entropy_before, ast_nodes_before, delta_*).
notes.evaluation_set: The primary evaluation set is 360 malicious against 255 size-matched controls, prevalence 0.5854. This is the primary configuration, used for the headline ROC-AUC, PR-AUC and threshold-0.5 confusion matrix; the within-package and unmatched-control designs are recorded separately in this file and are also quoted in the manuscript.
notes.model: All values in this file were produced with HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300), class-weighted, under StratifiedGroupKFold(5) grouped on package.
